newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index eases in downward market.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index eases in downward market.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM) share index Semdex eased by 0.64 points to 367.85 on Wednesday reflecting a market which was mostly moving downwards, brokers said.
Transactions totalled 14.85 million rupees on 386,070 shares from 9.36 million rupees on 286,060 shares on Monday.
Brokers said most moving stocks were on the downside in the absence of buying interest in the market.
"Recently, the market on the whole was generally on the downside but the slide of the index was limited by foreign investors buying the blue chips in the hotel and banking sectors," one broker said.
"But now, we even see that these blue chips are starting to lose ground. In fact, the market is looking for fresh news that would give it a new impetus," the broker added.
Foreign investors were not seen absent from the market owing to high activity in New Mauritius Hotels shares.
The hotel shares jumped by 90 cents to 35.10 rupees on a heavy 98,952 shares, accounting for around a quarter of the total volume.
But the effect of a rising New Mauritius Hotels was offset by falling shares of other big firms such as Mauritius Commercial Bank and Air Mauritius, bourse officials said.

Mauritius Commercial Bank fell by one rupee to 84.50 rupees on 26,194 shares and Air Mauritius was 60 cents down to 43.30 rupees on 5,720 shares. State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 11.10 rupees on 24,100 shares but Swan Insurance slumped by 2.60 rupees to 40.50 rupees on 3,561 shares.

Conglomerate Rogers was unchanged at 99 rupees on 32,820 shares and sugar based Mon Tresor Mon Desert remained at 38.90 rupees on 4,601 shares. Mauritius Breweries gained 5.0 rupees to 140 on 9,669 shares and Mauritius Oil Refineries was 20 cents up to 10.20 rupees on 4,230 shares.
In the investment sector, Promotion And Development was stable at 15.40 rupees on 34,187 shares while Mauritius Development Investment Trust shed 10 cents to 8.40 rupees on 14,010 shares.
National Investment Trust eased by 10 cents to 12.20 rupees on 11,750 shares and hotel concern Sun Resorts shed 60 cents to 44 rupees on 37,493 shares.
